---
title: "Testing User Interactivity"
resources:
  - shinylive-sw.js
---

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true

from shiny import ui, render, App,reactive

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.input_text("name", "Batter Name:"),
    ui.input_select("year", "Batter Year:", 
        choices=["2023", "2024", "2025"]
    ),
    ui.input_action_button("submit", "Enter"),
    ui.output_text("result"),
    style="width: 400px; height: 500px; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid #ccc;"
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @reactive.event(input.submit)
    @output
    @render.text
    def result():
        return f"Hello, {input.name()} from {input.year()}!"

app = App(app_ui,server)
```
